title: Image and clinical-factor ROC curves
scope: AUROC source table is included. Exact ROC curves use authorized participant predictions; rendering accepts ROC coordinates.

title: Fusion-model SHAP importance and participant distribution
scope: Panel A uses the aggregate 20-imputation importance table. Panel B uses signed SHAP values and features from representative imputation 9 in the authorized environment.

title: Performance across age, sex, HbA1c, and ethnicity groups
scope: Reported subgroup estimates and independent-sample DeLong comparisons are included. HbA1c groups use cohort-specific mean completion before the 7% split; internal groups contain 1,255 and 6,076 participants. Analysis commands use authorized participant predictions.

title: Retinal-structure retention and removal
scope: The released image checkpoints provide the full-image reference. Structure-specific runs use their own validation-selected checkpoints. See the 0–24 index map in docs/ABLATION.md.

title: Adjusted associations of retinal-structure scores
scope: The 45 aggregate rows supply the forest plot. Score effects are per sample SD, with likelihood-profile confidence intervals. Participant-level regression requires authorized scores and clinical tables.

title: Study design
scope: Study diagram; no fitted model is required.

title: Cohort characteristics
scope: Displayed clinical summaries and P values are supplied. The helper module provides descriptive, missingness, comparison, and standardized-difference calculations.

title: Clinical models and image–clinical fusion
scope: The CSV preserves the manuscript values, confidence intervals, and calibration estimates. Statistical functions accept aligned participant outcomes and predictions.

title: Implementation details
scope: Implementation summary; see docs/TRAINING_AND_TESTING.md for commands.

title: Imputation sensitivity
scope: Run each prepared imputation scheme with the same clinical/fusion workflow.

title: Classifier comparison
scope: The command selects lr, lda, lsvm, rbfsvm, rf, or gbc. Validation AUROC selects hyperparameters.

title: Subgroup performance
scope: Reported subgroup estimates and independent-sample DeLong comparisons are included. HbA1c groups use cohort-specific mean completion before the 7% split; internal groups contain 1,255 and 6,076 participants. Analysis commands use authorized participant predictions.

title: Clinical variable definitions
scope: Definition table and fusion-model input contract.

title: Missingness and imputed characteristics
scope: Displayed before/after-imputation summaries are supplied; clinical-table processing uses authorized data.

title: Segmentation and localization model characteristics
scope: Reported upstream model characteristics are supplied as a table. The linked code consumes their prepared masks for retinal-structure experiments; it is not a segmentation-model training script.

title: Backbone comparison
scope: Four architecture-specific comparisons and the matched seed-0 TinyNet-C/DeiT-Tiny comparison are supplied.

title: Computational efficiency
scope: Parameter counts and two-eye computational cost use the same ptflops backend.

title: Bilateral and single-eye comparison
scope: Left-eye, right-eye, averaged single-eye scores, and the bilateral model are separate comparisons.

title: Incremental discrimination of structure scores
scope: The retinal-structure runner with --discrimination calculates the exploratory AUC, paired DeLong, and likelihood-ratio comparisons against the clinical-covariate-only model. Reported estimates are supplied as CSV.

title: Vessel features and measured PWV
scope: 27 available-pair participant-mean associations with PWV, with bootstrap intervals and BH correction.

title: Vessel features and image-model score
scope: The same 27-measurement family, using the image probability as target.

title: Frozen-feature vessel probes
scope: 81 probe results from 27 targets and three predictor sets, with a common 5,187-participant cohort.

title: Included and excluded cohort characteristics
scope: Displayed characteristics and standardized mean differences are supplied.

title: PWV device distribution
scope: Aggregate device counts; identifiers and device assignments remain in authorized inputs.

title: Device-specific model performance
scope: Two-device comparison using the supplied subgroup membership.

title: Participating-center group comparison
scope: Reported A/B comparison among participating centers; use the corresponding site-provided group assignments for recalculation.

title: Screening-cost assumptions
scope: Nominal 2014 CNY and the specified incremental-imaging-cost assumptions.

title: Screening operating points
scope: Retrospectively selected operating points; confusion counts and three-decimal thresholds are supplied.

title: Direct screening costs
scope: Per-participant costs can be recalculated directly from the aggregate confusion counts.

title: Cohort flow
scope: Aggregate cohort-flow diagram.

title: Study sites and participant distribution
scope: The submitted aggregate map and participant-distribution visual are included; site plotting inputs are supplied through the corresponding author.

title: Decision curves and calibration
scope: The submitted visual uses adaptive Hosmer–Lemeshow grouping with g=431, df=429, P=0.193. The utility file supplies the net-benefit point at 0.20. Full curves use authorized predictions.

title: Image and fusion architecture
scope: Architecture diagram and selected model assets.

title: Nonlinear associations with metabolic markers
scope: The submitted metabolic-marker curves are supplied. Curve-specific analysis inputs are managed by the corresponding author; these curves have metabolic outcomes, distinct from the AS-outcome analysis in Figure 5.

title: Integrated Gradients attribution
scope: The article supplies the two-eye illustration. Code defines mean-image and blurred-image baselines. Run attribution with authorized retinal images and their matching image model.

title: Screening-cost scenarios
scope: Render from aggregate counts and cost assumptions; no model fitting is required.

title: Proposed screening pathway
scope: Proposed workflow diagram; no fitted model is required.
